name: Verify phone and email leads with Zelnum via HTTP Request

parameters.content:
# Verify phone and email leads with Zelnum via HTTP Request

## Who is this for?

Verify a phone number or email lead before updating a CRM or starting an outreach workflow. Built for operations teams and developers, this template uses Zelnum's realtime API through n8n's built-in HTTP Request nodes.

## What it does

Loads the current product catalog, validates your products, and requests a non-billable quote. Checks require explicit billing approval and a USDT spending limit. Output preserves each product's `valid`, `invalid`, or `unknown` verdict, billing status, and error code. Inconclusive answers require manual review; they are not treated as invalid.

## How to set up

1. [Register with Zelnum](https://app.zelnum.com), open API Center, and create an API key.
2. Create a Header Auth credential: name `X-API-Key`, value your private key. Select it on both authenticated HTTP Request nodes.
3. Configure your identifier, series, current product IDs, and request key. Run with `execute_billable=false` to inspect pricing.
4. Set your spending limit and enable billing only when ready. Keep the same key and inputs for retries.

## Requirements and customization

Requires a funded Zelnum account for paid checks and compatible built-in n8n nodes. After testing, replace the manual trigger with an authenticated CRM or form trigger. Verdicts describe the selected product, not contact consent or guaranteed email deliverability.

Read the [Zelnum API documentation](https://docs.zelnum.com) for coverage, billing, and errors. Visit [Zelnum](https://zelnum.com) for the platform overview.

nodes.name: Step 1 — choose a contact and products

parameters.content:
## 1. Configure and validate
Use the Edit Fields node. Select 1–10 numeric realtime IDs from the current catalog, all matching `series`. Phone accepts a national number with country or a complete E.164 number. Email omits country automatically.

Input is one contact per execution; no example contacts or real customer data are shipped.

## 2. Quote-only by default
The first run stops at the quote preview. Inspect cost in USDT. Set `max_total_usdt` and `execute_billable=true` only when you approve paid work. Paid execution requests a fresh quote and sends that exact body; no stale preview token is reused.

## 3. Run and route the result
Attach your CRM or other downstream node after the output. Inspect `verification_state` and each product result. `manual_review` covers unknown/refunded/error items; do not label them invalid.

`all_valid` refers only to the chosen products, not marketing consent, identity ownership, or guaranteed delivery.

## Private credential setup
Create one **Header Auth** credential: Name `X-API-Key`; Value your private key from [API Center](https://app.zelnum.com). Select it on the quote and paid-check HTTP nodes. The public catalog needs no credential.

## Retries
Choose a unique `idempotency_key` for each logical contact/product request; keep the same inputs and key after timeout, 409, 429 or 500. Use a new key only for a genuinely new request. Do not pin real contacts or export credentials. Saved execution data is disabled by default.

[Realtime reference](https://docs.zelnum.com/realtime-check/) · [Email reference](https://docs.zelnum.com/realtime-email/) · [Errors](https://docs.zelnum.com/errors/)
